name: Password Manager
summary: Password Manager is a free browser-based party game for 2-6 players. Players receive a call from Ralph, a panicked office worker whose boss has been locked out of his computer. Players work together using word association to build a long, memorable password from a box of floppy disks found on the desk. Each player must justify how their chosen word connects to the previous one. Once the password is complete, players must remember and re-enter it correctly with only three attempts. Best played in person or on a call with friends.
